## DayZ Server Manager v1.0.3

Fixes **ModCheck / SteamCMD** when several DayZ servers share one Workshop content folder (`w:{workshop_id}` cache).

### Download

**`dayz_manager-v1.0.3-windows-x64.zip`** — contains:

- `DayZManager.exe`
- `web/` (UI)
- `bercon-cli.exe`
- `config/config-host-template.json`

See [docs/RELEASES.md](https://github.com/devmrbouh-hub/dayz_manager/blob/main/docs/RELEASES.md).

### Highlights

- Shared mod version cache migration uses **min** per Workshop ID (not max) so one server cannot hide updates for all.
- Detects stale Workshop files via API `time_updated` vs newest file mtime in `content/221100/<id>`.
- SteamCMD failure fallback no longer poisons `mod_versions.json`; ModCheck retries until download succeeds.
- Locked reads/writes of `mod_versions.json` for parallel ModCheck on multi-server hosts.

### Upgrading from v1.0.2

Replace **both** `DayZManager.exe` and the entire `web\` folder. Do not overwrite your working `config\config.json`.

If mods were stuck with a wrong cache, delete affected `w:…` lines from `data/mod_versions.json` next to the EXE (optional) and wait for the next ModCheck cycle.
